headline: Pakistan Cabinet Approves Sugar Deregulation Policy to Meet Key IMF Requirement
summary: Pakistan's federal cabinet approved the National Policy for Deregulation of Sugar Sector to fulfill a postponed structural benchmark under its IMF program. The policy ends export subsidies and permits free inter-provincial sugar trade.
why: Fulfilling structural benchmarks is mandatory for Pakistan to receive funding disbursements under its IMF loan program.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Pakistan deregulated its sugar sector to comply with IMF structural benchmarks.
